inventory.list.title.description: Top-bar title of the Inventory tab's stock screen listing every item with quantity and FIFO value.

inventory.list.search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box that filters the current-inventory list by item name.

inventory.list.quantity_with_unit.description: Stock amount on a list row. {quantity} is the numeric stock, {unit} is the localized unit label (e.g. Pieces, Kg).

inventory.list.last_updated.description: Last-transaction date on a current-inventory row. {date} is a locale-formatted date.

inventory.list.empty_title.description: Title of the empty state on the current-inventory screen when the business has no master items.

inventory.list.empty_message.value: पहले सामान की सूची में सामान जोड़ें, फिर लेन-देन दर्ज करें — स्टॉक यहाँ दिखेगा।
inventory.list.empty_message.description: Body of the empty state on the current-inventory screen guiding the user to the item list.

inventory.list.no_results.value: आपकी खोज से मेल खाता कोई सामान नहीं मिला।
inventory.list.no_results.description: Shown instead of the list when the search query filters out every item.

inventory.toggle.masterlist.description: Explanation/label of the top-bar icon that switches from the stock screen to the item (master) list screen.

inventory.toggle.stock.description: Explanation/label of the top-bar icon that switches from the item list back to the stock screen.

inventory.fab.record_transaction.description: Explanation/content description of the + floating button on the stock screen that opens the record-transaction dialog.

inventory.image.expanded.description: Content description of the enlarged item photo shown after tapping a row's thumbnail; also names the close affordance context.

inventory.txn.title.description: Title of the dialog for recording an add/remove inventory transaction.

inventory.txn.item_label.description: Label of the type-ahead item picker in the record-transaction dialog.

inventory.txn.type_add.description: Toggle option: transaction adds stock (a purchase/in movement).

inventory.txn.type_remove.description: Toggle option: transaction removes stock (consumed FIFO from the oldest lots).

inventory.txn.quantity_label.description: Label of the required quantity input in the record-transaction dialog.

inventory.txn.unit_price_label.description: Label of the per-unit price input (rupees), required for Add transactions. Removes derive cost from FIFO lots.

inventory.txn.notes_label.description: Label of the optional notes input in the record-transaction dialog.

inventory.txn.stock_available.description: Helper line under the item picker showing current stock of the selected item. {quantity} numeric, {unit} localized unit.

inventory.txn.error_item_required.value: सुझावों में से कोई सामान चुनें।
inventory.txn.error_item_required.description: Validation error when saving a transaction without picking an item from the type-ahead list.

inventory.txn.error_quantity_invalid.description: Validation error for a missing, zero or non-numeric quantity.

inventory.txn.error_price_invalid.description: Validation error for a missing or non-numeric unit price on an Add transaction.

inventory.txn.error_insufficient_stock.value: स्टॉक कम है — सिर्फ़ {quantity} {unit} बचा है।
inventory.txn.error_insufficient_stock.description: Validation error when a Remove asks for more than the current stock. {quantity} is the available stock, {unit} its localized unit.

inventory.masterlist.title.description: Top-bar title of the master-item management screen.

inventory.masterlist.add_title.description: Title of the dialog for creating a new master item; also the FAB explanation on the item list screen.

inventory.masterlist.edit_title.description: Title of the dialog when editing an existing master item.

inventory.masterlist.name_label.description: Label of the required item-name input in the item editor dialog.

inventory.masterlist.unit_label.description: Label of the unit dropdown in the item editor dialog.

inventory.masterlist.unit_pieces.description: Unit dropdown option for countable pieces (stored as wire value 'pcs').

inventory.masterlist.unit_quantity.description: Unit dropdown option for generic quantity (stored as wire value 'qty').

inventory.masterlist.unit_kg.description: Unit dropdown option for kilograms (stored as wire value 'kg').

inventory.masterlist.unit_litre.description: Unit dropdown option for litres (stored as wire value 'litre').

inventory.masterlist.unit_custom.description: Unit dropdown option that reveals a free-text field for the user's own unit.

inventory.masterlist.custom_unit_label.description: Label of the free-text unit input shown when Custom is picked in the unit dropdown.

inventory.masterlist.photo_pick.description: Button that opens the system photo picker in the item editor. The picked image is cropped square and compressed.

inventory.masterlist.photo_remove.description: Button that clears the currently selected item photo in the item editor.

inventory.masterlist.similar_items_hint.value: क्या आपका मतलब इनमें से कोई है?
inventory.masterlist.similar_items_hint.description: Hint shown above the fuzzy duplicate-suggestion chips while typing a new item name.

inventory.masterlist.error_name_required.description: Validation error when saving a master item with a blank name.

inventory.masterlist.error_unit_required.description: Validation error when the Custom unit option is picked but the free-text unit is blank.

inventory.masterlist.error_duplicate_nam.value: इस नाम का सामान पहले से है।
inventory.masterlist.error_duplicate_nam.description: Validation error when saving a master item whose name exactly matches another item (names are unique per business).

inventory.masterlist.delete_confirm_titl.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before deleting a master item.

inventory.masterlist.delete_confirm_mess.value: {name} सामान की सूची से हट जाएगा।
inventory.masterlist.delete_confirm_mess.description: Body of the delete confirmation dialog. {name} is the item's name.

inventory.masterlist.delete_blocked.value: इस सामान के लेन-देन दर्ज हैं, इसलिए इसे हटाया नहीं जा सकता।
inventory.masterlist.delete_blocked.description: Shown when deletion is refused because inventory transactions exist for the item (the can-delete rule).

inventory.masterlist.empty_title.description: Title of the empty state on the item list screen when no master items exist.

inventory.masterlist.empty_message.value: शुरू करने के लिए फ़ोटो और इकाई के साथ सामान जोड़ें।
inventory.masterlist.empty_message.description: Body of the empty state on the item list screen.

inventory.list.all_zero_title.description: Title of the empty state on the current-inventory screen when items exist but every one has zero stock (zero-quantity rows are hidden).

inventory.list.all_zero_message.value: सभी सामान शून्य पर हैं। स्टॉक लाने के लिए जोड़ें लेन-देन दर्ज करें।
inventory.list.all_zero_message.description: Body of the all-at-zero empty state on the current-inventory screen guiding the user to record an Add transaction.

inventory.txn.saved_add.description: Snackbar confirmation after an Add transaction is recorded.

inventory.txn.saved_remove.value: स्टॉक हटा दिया गया। कुल लागत: {amount}
inventory.txn.saved_remove.description: Snackbar confirmation after a Remove transaction. {amount} is the FIFO cost of the removed stock, formatted as rupees.

inventory.txn.total_preview.description: Live total shown in the Add form once quantity and unit price both parse. {amount} is quantity × unit price, formatted as rupees.

inventory.txn.option_available.description: Availability note under each item suggestion in Remove mode. {quantity} is the current stock, {unit} its localized unit label.

inventory.detail.back.description: Explanation/content description of the back arrow on the item detail screen.

inventory.detail.total_value.description: Label of the FIFO total stock value shown in the item detail header.

inventory.detail.transactions_title.description: Section heading above the transaction list on the item detail screen.

inventory.detail.showing_count.value: {total} में से {shown} लेन-देन दिख रहे हैं
inventory.detail.showing_count.description: Pagination status under the transaction list. {shown} is the number currently visible, {total} the item's full transaction count.

inventory.detail.load_more.description: Button that reveals the next page of transactions on the item detail screen.

inventory.detail.empty.value: इस सामान का अभी कोई लेन-देन नहीं है।
inventory.detail.empty.description: Empty state of the transaction list on the item detail screen.

inventory.detail.qty_at_price.description: Per-transaction line on the item detail screen: quantity, localized unit and per-unit price (rupees).

inventory.masterlist.similar_chip.description: Label of a fuzzy duplicate-suggestion chip. {name} is the existing item's name, {percent} the similarity percentage.
